svg.aria-label: zero dependencies: built on go's standard library only.; tls verify-full: verifies the server certificate and host name on every tcp connection unless `sslmode=disable`.; channel-bound scram: authenticates with scram-sha-256-plus, bound to the server's certificate.; downgrade protection: rejects md5, trust, unbound scram and cleartext authentication over tls.; atomic batches: sends multiple statements in one write and one round trip, applied all or nothing.; transaction safety: rolls back any batch that leaves a transaction open.; commit-state reporting: returns `ErrCommitUnknown` when a commit receives no response.; listen and notify: `Wait` delivers notifications in order, oldest first.; typed server errors: server errors are `*pg.Error` values with sqlstate, detail and constraint.; credential-safe errors: errors never include any part of the connection url.; deterministic sessions: utf8, utc and exact float output regardless of server defaults.; fuzz testing: four fuzzers cover server responses, tls and scram.
